rules.title: Convention over configuration
rules.text: Follow Rails conventions for naming, routing and file layout.

rules.title: Strong parameters
rules.text: Permit parameters explicitly with strong parameters.

rules.title: Service objects
rules.text: Keep controllers thin and move complex logic into service objects.

rules.title: Avoid N+1
rules.text: Use includes to avoid N+1 queries and add database indexes for foreign keys.

rules.title: Limit callbacks
rules.text: Avoid model callbacks for business logic; call services explicitly.

rules.title: Background jobs
rules.text: Run slow work in Active Job with idempotent jobs.

rules.title: Safe migrations
rules.text: Write reversible migrations and use strong_migrations rules for zero-downtime changes.

rules.title: Encrypted credentials
rules.text: Store secrets in encrypted credentials or environment variables.
